title: Media Inspect
description: Inspects media file properties: duration, dimensions, framerate, audio presence, loudness (integrated LUFS via ebur128), and extracts sample frames

path.description: Workspace-relative path to audio or video file

width.description: Video width in pixels, or null if audio-only

height.description: Video height in pixels, or null if audio-only

fps.description: Video framerate, or null if audio-only

has_audio.description: True if an audio stream is present

loudness_lufs.description: Integrated loudness in LUFS via ebur128, or null if no audio

sample_frames.description: Workspace-relative paths to PNG frames captured at 10%, 50%, and 90% of duration
